name: Hefei Department Store Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Hefei Department Store Group Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, trades and markets retail and agricultural products in China. The company offers department stores, home appliances, supermarket chains, e-commerce, electrical appliances stores, cross-border direct sales, agricultural product wholesale markets, and standardized vegetable markets. It is also involved in online and offline integration, as well as domestic and foreign trade industrial system services. The company was founded in 1959 and is based in Hefei, China.
